mitre_techniques.description: Adversaries may gather host information such as software versions from response headers.

mitigations.title: Implement Missing OWASP Security Headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff)
mitigations.description: Configure defensive HTTP response headers to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Clickjacking, and MIME-sniffing.
actionable_steps: In FastAPI: Add middleware setting Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options: DENY, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
In Express.js: Run 'npm install helmet' and add 'app.use(helmet())'.
In Next.js: Configure headers in next.config.js under 'async headers()'.
In Nginx: Add directives 'add_header X-Frame-Options DENY always;' and 'add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff always;'.

mitigations.title: Mask Technology Fingerprints (Server & X-Powered-By)
mitigations.description: Remove framework banners ('uvicorn') to impede adversary reconnaissance.
actionable_steps: In Uvicorn/FastAPI: Run with '--no-server-header' or strip the header in middleware.
